sampling: last recorded servo tick at or before each 30 Hz display time; nearest landmark receipt to last_landmarks_received_monotonic_s
matching: same-host monotonic reception times, not exposure synchronization
limitations: MuJoCo playback of recorded measured joint angles, not raw Hybrid targets, new physical execution or proof of contact accuracy.
selection_basis: Search all four thumb-to-fingertip distances for consecutive distinct-finger pinches, compare four cycles, measured angular changes, FK distal-surface gaps and visual views; not an exhaustive optimum
pinch_evidence_note: Model collision-proxy distances over human pinch samples (<30 mm), before 26.7s. They guide segment selection; they do not measure real skin contact or prove perfect retargeting.
